blocks.text: 我们推出 GPT-6.1 Terra，这是一款快速、高效的模型，将细致的视觉推理与精准的计算机使用能力相结合，同时具备更清晰、更自然的写作能力。相比 GPT‑5.6 Terra 有显著提升，它擅长处理填满工作日的沟通和计算机任务，从起草提案、解读技术图纸到填写表单和编辑视频。

blocks.text: Terra 继续推进我们各模型系列在成本-智能前沿上的进展，在速度、能力和成本之间提供新的平衡。其标准 API 价格比 GPT-5.6 Terra 和 GPT-6.1 Sol 低 50%，使开发者能够以实用成本自动化大批量工作，例如读取收到的发票并将其详细信息录入会计软件。在 ChatGPT Work 和 Codex 中，你的套餐搭配 GPT-6.1 Terra 能发挥更大价值——相同的使用额度可覆盖比 GPT‑5.6 Terra 更多的任务，且远多于 GPT‑6.1 Sol 或 GPT‑6 Astra。

blocks.text: 我们在 Agents’ Last Exam 上测量了 GPT-6.1 Terra 的计算机使用能力，该基准包含专业任务，例如将建筑图纸转化为 3D 模型，以及逐镜头审阅动画影片，为修复团队创建带时间码的日志。在中等推理强度下，GPT-6.1 Terra 的得分比 GPT-5.6 Terra 高 15 个百分点，成本约为其三分之一。它甚至以仅为 GPT-6 Astra 每 token 十分之一的价格，达到与其相当的性能。在最大推理强度下，Terra 的 token 效率是 Claude Opus 5.5 的三倍以上，每 token 价格为其四分之一，使每任务成本降低约 9 倍。Terra 的速度也快得多，完成任务比 GPT-6 Astra 和 GPT-6.1 Sol 都快三倍以上。

inlines.text: 事实性和编程能力显著提升

blocks.text: 今年，我们大力投入减少模型产生的幻觉和事实性错误。在我们内部的诱导错误提示基准上，低推理强度下的错误率从 GPT-5.6 Terra 的 53.6% 降至 GPT-6.1 Terra 的 16.7%，下降了近 37 个百分点。在最大推理强度下，错误率下降了 18 个百分点至 4.3%，几乎与 GPT-6 Astra 和 GPT-6.1 Sol 的错误率持平。

blocks.text: GPT-6.1 Terra 在软件工程方面相比 GPT-5.6 Terra 有显著提升。Terminal-Bench 4.0 测试编程智能体在命令行中解决问题的能力，例如修复一个在加载时布局发生偏移的网页。在最高推理强度下，GPT‑6.1 Terra 解决了 50.3% 的任务，是 GPT‑5.6 Terra 已公布得分 21.5% 的两倍多。对于最复杂的编程任务，GPT-6.1 Sol 和 GPT-6 Astra 仍是更好的选择。

Delivering fast and capable computer use at scale

inlines.text: Delivering fast and capable computer use at scale

blocks.text: We’re introducing GPT-6.1 Terra, a fast, efficient model that combines detailed visual reasoning and precise computer use alongside clearer, more natural writing. A significant step up from GPT‑5.6 Terra, it excels at the communication and computer-based tasks that fill the workday, from drafting proposals and interpreting technical drawings to filling out forms and editing videos.

A significant step up from GPT‑5.6 Terra, it excels at the communication and computer-based tasks that fill the workday, from drafting proposals and interpreting technical drawings to filling out forms and editing videos.

blocks.text: Terra continues to advance the cost-intelligence frontier across our model families, providing a new balance of speed, capability, and cost. Its standard API prices are 50% lower than those of GPT-5.6 Terra and GPT-6.1 Sol, making it practical for developers to automate high-volume work, like reading incoming invoices and entering their details into accounting software. In ChatGPT Work and Codex, your plan goes further with GPT-6.1 Terra—the same usage allowance covers more tasks than with GPT‑5.6 Terra and substantially more than with GPT‑6.1 Sol or GPT‑6 Astra.

blocks.text: We measured GPT-6.1 Terra’s computer-use capabilities on Agents’ Last Exam, a benchmark of professional tasks that includes turning architectural drawings into a 3D model and reviewing an animated film shot by shot to create a time-coded log for a restoration team. At medium reasoning effort, GPT-6.1 Terra scores 15 percentage points higher than GPT-5.6 Terra at about one-third the cost. It even performs on par with GPT-6 Astra at only one-tenth its price per token. At max effort, Terra is over three times as token efficient as Claude Opus 5.5, and one-fourth its price per token, resulting in a ~9x lower cost per task. Terra is also much quicker, completing tasks over three times faster than both GPT-6 Astra and GPT-6.1 Sol.

blocks.text: A significant step up on factuality and coding

inlines.text: A significant step up on factuality and coding

blocks.text: This year, we’ve invested heavily in reducing hallucinations and factual errors produced by our models. On our internal benchmark of error-inducing prompts, the error rate at low reasoning effort fell from 53.6% with GPT-5.6 Terra to 16.7% with GPT-6.1 Terra, a drop of nearly 37 percentage points. At maximum effort, the error rate fell by 18 percentage points to 4.3%, nearly matching the rates for GPT-6 Astra and GPT-6.1 Sol.

blocks.text: GPT-6.1 Terra marks a substantial improvement over GPT-5.6 Terra for software engineering. Terminal-Bench 4.0 tests how well coding agents solve problems from the command line, such as fixing a webpage whose layout shifts as it loads. At maximum reasoning effort, GPT‑6.1 Terra solves 50.3% of tasks, more than double GPT‑5.6 Terra’s published score of 21.5%. For the most complex coding tasks, GPT-6.1 Sol and GPT-6 Astra remain the better choice.
